reasons.node_class:
NPX-5053C (10 Nov 2026, live on VM .68, 6-vCPU KVM): run csr3 took 1792 s from power-on to
"%CVAC-4-CONFIG_DONE" (the "<5 s" above is the bootloader prompt, not IOS-XE); with 360 s the user saw
"Startup config did not apply" while CVAC applied it 24 min later. Run csr5: the fresh overlay's first boot
fsck-repaired its 10 partitions for 32 min (%IOSXEBOOT-4-FILESYS_REPAIR, I/O bound), IOS-XE up at 2717 s,
2400 had expired 5 min earlier. 3600 = slower sample + 1/3; the CVAC marker watch spans this same budget.
reasons.day0_channel:

day0_channel - so a pasted startup config built no CVAC ISO and the guest sat in the
